generator_cmd: printf %s 'Meet me by the old mill at dawn, bring the map' | xxd -p | tr -d '\n'  # plain big-endian hex, no swap
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | xxd -r -p  # reads as English UNswapped; the 2/4/8 swaps read worse -> not a word-swap line
oracle_plain: Meet me by the old mill at dawn, bring the map
